summary: Circular pixel progress ring with the percentage counting up in its centre; it turns green and throws a few sparks when it reaches 100%.

props.name: value
props.description: Progress from 0 to 100, clamped; the ring animates to it. `null` or leaving it out shows a spinning arc.

props.name: children
props.description: Caption under the ring; it also labels the progress bar.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called when `value` reaches 100, and again each time it drops below 100 and returns, also while the ring is off screen. Not called when the ring starts at 100.

accessibility: The ring is a `div` with `role="progressbar"`, `aria-valuemin="0"`, `aria-valuemax="100"` and `aria-valuenow`, which is left out when indeterminate.
The canvas and the percentage inside it are `aria-hidden`; the number is the visible form of `aria-valuenow`.
With a caption the ring is labelled by it through `aria-labelledby`; without one its `aria-label` is "Progress".
motion: With reduced motion the ring and the number jump to the value, no sparks fire at 100%, and the indeterminate arc holds still.
notes: The ring starts at the first `value` instead of filling up from 0.
The percentage is text in the mono font with tabular figures, 27% of `size` high, and counts along with the fill. It turns green at 100%; the indeterminate ring shows no number.
